<!doctype html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#17382d">
<title>The Village Villas – Dead Sea | Villa 1</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');
:root{--green:#17382d;--green2:#244b3c;--lime:#b9d35d;--cream:#f8f5ed;--ink:#202723;--muted:#6d756f;--beige:#e9dfcc;--white:#fff;--line:#e7e0d4;--shadow:0 22px 65px rgba(20,40,31,.15)}
*{box-sizing:border-box} html{scroll-behavior:smooth} body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic','Cairo',sans-serif}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit} button{font:inherit}
.container{width:min(1120px,92%);margin:auto}
.nav{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;z-index:50;background:rgba(23,56,45,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);padding:12px 0}
.nav-in{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px}
.brand{color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:17px} .brand small{display:block;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.6px;opacity:.72}
.nav-btn{background:var(--lime);color:var(--green);font-weight:800;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px}
.hero{height:92svh;min-height:620px;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:end;overflow:hidden;background:#111}
.hero img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.14),rgba(5,18,13,.83))}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:2;color:#fff;padding:150px 0 68px}
.kicker,.eyebrow{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.7px;color:var(--lime)}
h1{font-family:Cairo,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(42px,8vw,82px);line-height:1.03;margin:10px 0 18px;letter-spacing:-1.8px}
.hero p{max-width:650px;font-size:clamp(16px,2.4vw,21px);line-height:1.9;color:rgba(255,255,255,.87);margin:0}
.actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:25px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:13px 20px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:800;border:1px solid transparent}
.primary{background:var(--lime);color:var(--green)} .secondary{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.price{margin-top:18px;font-size:13px;opacity:.9}
.section{padding:82px 0} .head{margin-bottom:26px} .head h2{font-family:Cairo,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(29px,5vw,48px);margin:7px 0 0;line-height:1.15} .head p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.9;max-width:680px}
/* SINGLE GALLERY */
.gallery-shell{background:#101713;border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);color:#fff}
.gallery-top{padding:25px 28px 16px;display:flex;align-items:start;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#16241d,#101713)}
.gallery-top h3{font-family:Cairo,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(23px,4vw,36px);margin:5px 0 5px} .gallery-top p{margin:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);line-height:1.7}
.counter{white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.viewer{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/10;background:#0b0f0c;overflow:hidden}
.viewer img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:opacity .25s}
.arrow{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);background:rgba(0,0,0,.38);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:25px;cursor:pointer;z-index:3}
.arrow:hover{background:rgba(0,0,0,.65)} .prev{right:18px} .next{left:18px}
.gallery-bottom{padding:18px 24px 23px;background:#101713}
.gallery-bottom strong{display:block;font-size:16px;margin-bottom:5px} .gallery-bottom span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-size:14px}
.thumbs{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:12px 20px 17px;background:#0b0f0c;scrollbar-width:thin}
.thumb{flex:0 0 76px;height:58px;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid transparent;opacity:.62;cursor:pointer}
.thumb.active{border-color:var(--lime);opacity:1} .thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:5px;margin-top:10px} .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#536059;cursor:pointer} .dot.active{background:var(--lime);width:18px;border-radius:9px}
.features{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(30,35,30,.045)}
.card .ico{width:42px;height:42px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#edf2dc;border-radius:13px;color:var(--green);font-size:20px;margin-bottom:16px}
.card h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:18px} .card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8;font-size:14px}
.location{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr .9fr;gap:18px;align-items:stretch}
.location-card{background:var(--green);color:#fff;border-radius:28px;padding:35px}
.location-card h2{font-family:Cairo,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,45px);margin:7px 0 14px}
.location-card p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);line-height:1.9}
.map-btn{margin-top:20px;background:var(--lime);color:var(--green)}
.mapbox{border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;min-height:340px;background:#ddd;position:relative}
.mapbox iframe{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:340px;border:0}
.reviews-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:22px}
.rating{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:15px 20px;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap}
.rating strong{display:block;font-size:30px;color:var(--green)} .rating span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.review-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}
.review{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px}
.stars{color:#d6a526;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:9px} .review h4{margin:0 0 7px} .review p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8;font-size:14px;margin:0}
.more-reviews{display:none;margin-top:14px} .more-reviews.show{display:grid}
.review-note{margin-top:18px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;background:#f0ece3;padding:14px 17px;border-radius:14px}
.show-more{display:block;margin:22px auto 0;background:var(--green);color:#fff;border:0;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:13px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#17382d,#0d231a);border-radius:30px;color:#fff;padding:54px 25px;text-align:center}
.cta h2{font-family:Cairo,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,48px);margin:8px 0} .cta p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);line-height:1.9}
.whatsapp{position:fixed;z-index:60;bottom:15px;left:15px;right:15px;max-width:520px;margin:auto;background:#25D366;color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:13px 18px;border-radius:17px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 14px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
footer{padding:38px 0 100px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:800px){.features,.review-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.location{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gallery-top{padding:21px 18px 14px}.viewer{aspect-ratio:4/5}}
@media(max-width:560px){.features,.review-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{min-height:650px}.hero-content{padding-bottom:58px}.actions .btn{width:100%}.viewer{aspect-ratio:4/5}.arrow{width:42px;height:42px}.prev{right:10px}.next{left:10px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

</div></nav>
